definition.name: approximate_unitary_t_design
definition.definition: A distribution P over the unitary group U(d) is an epsilon-approximate unitary t-design if the associated t-fold twirl channel C_t(eta) = E_{V~P}[V^{tensor t} eta (V^dag)^{tensor t}] satisfies (1-epsilon)H_t(eta) <= C_t(eta) <= (1+epsilon)H_t(eta) for all positive semidefinite eta, where H_t is the Haar t-fold twirl H_t(eta) = E_{U~Haar}[U^{tensor t} eta (U^dag)^{tensor t}]. Theorem 4.1: For d a power of 2 and any t, there exists a 1/2-approximate unitary t-design where each unitary is a log(d)-qubit circuit with poly(log(d)*t) gates, constructible in poly(log(d)*t) classical time.
